name: zendesk-whatsapp-audio-transcriber
description: Chrome extension that transcribes WhatsApp audio messages inside Zendesk Agent Workspace, locally with Whisper.

scripts.check: npm run lint && npm run format:check && npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
scripts.bench: npm run build:e2e && BENCH=1 HEADED=1 playwright test bench
scripts.store:assets: npm run zip:store && rm -rf publicacao && mkdir -p publicacao && cp .output-public/*.zip publicacao/ && cp public/icons/128.png publicacao/icone-128.png && cp docs/store-assets/01-transcricao.png publicacao/captura-1-transcricao.png && cp docs/store-assets/02-menu.png publicacao/captura-2-menu.png && cp docs/store-assets/03-privacidade.png publicacao/captura-3-privacidade.png && cp docs/store-assets/promo-440x280.png publicacao/promo-440x280.png && test "$(unzip -Z1 publicacao/*.zip | grep -c 'manifest.json$')" = 1 || (echo 'ERRO: o pacote deve ter um único manifest.json' && exit 1)
